sources.entry: DreamFactory - Turns any SQL/NoSQL/Structured data into Restful API. (Source Code) Apache-2.0 PHP/Docker/K8S

summary.one_liner: DreamFactory is a self-hosted platform that generates governed REST APIs over SQL, NoSQL, file storage and other data sources, with an built-in MCP server for AI and LLM access.
summary.what_it_does: It connects to a database, introspects its schema, and generates REST endpoints with CRUD operations, relationship retrieval, stored procedure access, filtering, sorting, pagination, and bulk operations. Each endpoint gets OpenAPI/Swagger documentation. Access is controlled through role-based permissions per table, endpoint and HTTP verb, plus API key management and several SSO options (SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, Azure AD, LDAP). The README also lists audit logging, rate limiting, field-level data masking, and server-side scripts in PHP, Python or Node.js for custom endpoint behavior. A built-in MCP server lets AI clients such as Claude or ChatGPT query data through these governed endpoints instead of generating raw SQL. Supported sources include MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle, SQLite, MongoDB, Cassandra, Couchbase, CouchDB, Snowflake, Databricks, S3, Azure Blob, SFTP and SMTP email. It is built on the Laravel framework.
use_cases: generate REST API from existing database without backend code
give ChatGPT or Claude governed access to company databases
wrap SQL Server or Oracle stored procedures in REST endpoints
replace hand-written CRUD backend for mobile or web apps
combine multiple databases behind a single API gateway
expose MongoDB or Cassandra data as REST API
how_to_run: git clone <repository URL (not given in README)>
git clone <df-docker repository URL (not given in README)>
notable: Built-in MCP server so AI models call governed REST endpoints rather than generating SQL
Auto-generates REST APIs and OpenAPI docs from database schema with no code generation step
Wide connector list spanning SQL, NoSQL, file storage, SOAP-to-REST and push notifications
Server-side scripting in PHP, Python or Node.js at any endpoint
Install options for Linux installers, Windows IIS/Apache, Docker Compose, Helm chart and npx
caveats: Some advanced connectors (SQL Server, Oracle, Snowflake, SOAP) and features like rate limiting, audit logging and multi-tenancy are described as part of a commercial edition
The README links out to separate repositories and guides for Windows, Docker and Helm setup rather than giving full instructions inline
Git clone URLs are blank in the README as provided
